---
title: "Approaches for robust assessments"
description: "Complementary approaches for preserving meaningful assessment."
---

This chapter is intended for the guide’s general approaches: making work more specific, observing the process, using oral interaction, clarifying the pedagogical contract, and treating AI use as a competence where relevant.

## Combine approaches

No single method is appropriate for every course. The strongest designs generally combine several modest measures rather than relying on one supposedly definitive safeguard.

::: {.callout-tip title="Practical rule"}
Start from the learning outcome, then choose the least burdensome combination of measures that provides credible evidence of learning.
:::
